liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **I Know You Rider** (3 reviews): Jerry belted out the northbound train line emphatically, seemingly looking right at the reviewer; Simulated locomotive headlights swept through the crowd during Jerry's headlight verse; reviewer ranks China>Rider among the all-time best [6][7][15]
- **Feel Like a Stranger** (1 review): Perky, well drawn-out version, reviewer says very similar to the 1989 Alpine one on the VHS/DVD release [13]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): About twenty seconds' pause before committing; the drummers stay in sync, letting the audience clap along [13]
- **The Wheel** (1 review): Jerry cut off Brent's apparent Gloria after Gimme Some Lovin' and went into The Wheel; the abruptness is audible [4]
- **All Along the Watchtower** (1 review): Reviewer says it was only the second time the band had played it, and a total surprise [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **Space cont**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-06-26.131214.datbrad.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 23 songs; 141 min; rated 2.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd87-06-26.bille.kerbel.8138.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 141 min; rated 4.34/5 by 32 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the audience recording is needed to truly feel the show's intensity; Reviewer finds the recording not very good, rating it four stars despite a superb performance [4][15]
- **gd1987-06-26.168706.pcm.schoeps.crandall.miller.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 147 min [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer held lawn tickets but got down to the third row on Jerry's side [6]
- Reviewer drove from Long Island for the run; second set featured odd effects throughout [8]
- After the show, reviewer and friends climbed the Alpine hillside for a view of the crowd's encampment [14]
- Reviewer calls it among the best Alpine Valley shows, with a phenomenal second set [4]
- Chicagoan reviewer calls it the most memorable of about a hundred shows seen, with a lasting second set [7]
- Reviewer enjoyed all three nights, but calls this Friday night one of the highest-energy shows seen [8]
- This was an evening show, while the following two Alpine shows were afternoon affairs [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-06-26.131214.datbrad.flac16**: taped by datbrad; transferred by datbrad; source: OTS 2 Nakamichi CM100s w/10v batt/cP4 shotguns(XY)>Sony TCD5M (Maxell MX90s); [1]
- **gd87-06-26.bille.kerbel.8138.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD> Nakamichi 300 microphones> Sony D5 deck> master cassette [2]
- **gd1987-06-26.168706.pcm.schoeps.crandall.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Crandall; transferred by Mastered by Charlie Miller  September 5, 2024; source: (FOB) Schoeps CMC3/MK4 > PCM Master > FLAC [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1987-06-27 Alpine Valley Music Theatre, East Troy, WI, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-06-27-alpine-valley-music-theatre-east-troy-wi-usa/) [17]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1987-06-26 Alpine Valley Music Theatre, East Troy, WI, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-06-26-alpine-valley-music-theatre-east-troy-wi-usa/) [18]
